description: Policy-driven CommandPolicy config for SecureCLIRunner. Edit to customize allowed commands, arg prefixes, timeouts, output sizes, env for grok/lattice/uws/alum etc. This turns the runner into a canonical interop contract. See Copilot upgrade suggestions in session.

policies.name: grok
policies.description: Canonical Grok CLI (canon diff/sync for specs, lattice ops)

policies.name: lattice
policies.description: Lattice query/apply for Atlas Lattice (12x12x12 coords, ClaimPackets)

policies.name: uws
policies.description: Universal Workspace CLI (UWS) from atlaslattice - 12k-20k+ unified features (Google/MS/Apple/Android/Chrome) into Aluminum OS

policies.name: alum
policies.description: Aluminum OS unified command surface (kernel over UWS drivers for provider abstraction)

policies.name: antigravity
policies.description: Google Antigravity CLI v2 (sandboxed agents, credential masking, hardened Git per I/O 2026)

policies.name: antigravity-harness
policies.description: Self-hosted Antigravity Agent Harness SDK alias

policies.name: adb
policies.description: Android Debug Bridge (restricted to safe commands for Vibe/Emulator testing)

policies.name: emulator
policies.description: Android Emulator direct (for Google AI Studio integration)

policies.name: git
policies.description: Git for canonical atlaslattice mirroring (scoped to projects/atlas-lattice-providers; safe ops only for canon/claims/ledgers sync + adversarial archive)

policies.name: gh
policies.description: GitHub CLI for advanced mirror (issues/PRs for adversarial review, api for file ops on canon)
